title: Diffract stack map: monster-pr — Q2 CLI Improvements
head: monster-pr
summary: This PR ships 7 Q2 CLI improvements to the click toolkit: tightened typing (R1), user-facing string localisation via gettext (R2), NoSuchCommand suggestions (R3), a new get_pager_file() API (R4), Linux prompt/hidden-input fixes (R5), Fish completion multi-line help (R6), and small targeted fixes (R7). The 96 units are stacked in dependency order — typing first, then features, then docs — so each slice can be reviewed and merged independently.

slices.title: Tighten Parameter/parser typing (mechanical — skim)
slices.note: 100% mechanical — skim for unwanted behaviour changes in Parameter/Option/Argument type narrowing and ABC introduction

slices.title: Add NoSuchCommand with name suggestions
slices.note: Check _format_possibilities suggestion logic and Group.invoke NoSuchCommand wiring; tests included

slices.title: Localise remaining user-facing strings
slices.note: 66 behavioural lines, no tests — verify every string goes through _() and .format() parameters are correct

slices.title: Add click.get_pager_file() pager API
slices.note: 183 behavioural lines, no automated tests (pager tests excluded) — review MaybeStripAnsi, _pager_contextmanager, and get_pager_file() manually

slices.title: Fix Linux prompt input and hidden-input errors
slices.note: Focus on _readline_prompt stdout/stderr redirect logic and _mask_hidden_input regex; 14 test cases included

slices.title: Fix Fish completion multi-line help strings
slices.note: Small and well-tested: check the newline-split parsing change in the completion script path

slices.title: Docs, small fixes, and unrelated changes
slices.note: Three R7 fixes are independent — can be pushed back separately; also contains unrelated .gitignore and File error reformat

gaps: R4 changes 183 behavioural lines in slices 4, 7 with no test changes
R2 changes 66 behavioural lines in slice 3 with no test changes
R1 changes 17 behavioural lines in slices 1, 2 with no test changes

timeline.text: Tested 7 slices in parallel (51.9 s); all green

requirements.text: Tighten typing of Parameter names, UNSET sentinel, option parser
Localise remaining user-facing strings via gettext
NoSuchCommand error with name suggestions; unknown options same format
Fix Linux prompt input; custom error for hidden-input prompts
Fish shell completion handles multi-line help strings
Small fixes: FuncParamType ValueError, Windows open_url, deprecation label
